checks.name: D1 the baryon-potential boundness edge is r_0 = sqrt(3) r_M (P2, exact) and sits below 0.15 r_e for M_b = 1e10, 1e11, 1e12 (the law is verified far beyond it)

D2 the energy and overdensity functionals are ON at the Sun's own centre (the turnaround functional theta_b <= 0 holds by definition for a bound virialised clump; not computed), with the overdensity margin over the MW's ~1e17
D3a the clump inside the host shares the host's M_top (it owns no phantom of its own); an isolated dwarf is its own top level
D3b the top-level ball boundary of an isolated, fully baryon-retaining system is r_e = 0.4 r_ta (Delta_edge = Delta_ta/x_e^3): no constant beyond B's declared x_e
D3c M_top is translation invariant (sup over all centres: no origin, no system-centre coordinate)
D3d M_top has a jump (fold) of a factor 2 at d_c = 2^(4/3) R_1: a Lagrangian term built from it has a delta-function variation at every merger unless a smoothing width is introduced
D3e the functional assigns identical values to an accreted satellite and a formed-embedded tidal dwarf with the same baryon state (it reads no history)
D4 (reported) the accreted/embedded distinction is a factor 2.8-26 in dynamical mass for the same baryon state

GE / energy boundness (baryon potential).why: edge at 0.05-0.11 of r_e; the phantom-inclusive potential has no edge without the reference r_ta (history / cosmology, not a state function)

GG(ii) / monotone functionals.why: every monotone-in-overdensity gate is ON at the Sun; the embedded system gets its own phantom (strict law 4.0-5.7x over the Cassini ceiling, CFG7 H1)

GC / maximal-ball functional.why: reads only baryon masses and positions

GD / maximal-ball functional.why: origin-free (D3c) and defined on the leaf geometry; leaf-covariance needs the foliation (CV-type preferred frame); no covariant field-theoretic definition written

GE / maximal-ball edge.why: the ball boundary reproduces r_e without a new constant (D3b) -- but as a FIELD gate the Gauss lemma of G1 still gives M_dyn = M_b beyond it

GA / maximal-ball functional.why: supremum over centres and radii: jump discontinuities at mergers (D3d); variation needs a smoothing width (new constant) and is defined only almost everywhere

GF / maximal-ball functional.why: one new constant at least (the merger-smoothing width); x_e is B's own declared item

GG(i) / any baryon-state functional.why: identical baryon state, identical gate value (D3e), different ownership (D4): a history variable that is not a function of the baryon state is required

GG(ii) / maximal-ball functional.why: nesting removes the Sun's own phantom (D3a) -- but it also makes every ACCRETED satellite Newtonian, contradicting CFG7's rule (accreted keep their infall halo)
